situation: Stainless stockholder (EUR 165 m group), 80% of the 1.4404 bar at EUR 5.45/kg under an AS-14404 clause (share 0.45, no deadband). Implied base price ex surcharge ~EUR 2.44/kg (5.45 - 3.01). Cheapest 1.4404 source (Werdenfels now 5.84).
